subject: BaseTools/EfiRom: fix compiler warning
reasons: This is a one-off compiler-warning fix in a single C file and a single function.
The change removes one unused local and inlines one `strstr()` check, which is not a repeated structural pattern.
There is no API migration, repeated call-site rewrite, or other collateral evolution for Coccinelle to generalize.
The transformation is context-specific cleanup rather than a reusable match-and-replace rule.
